raw.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.

reason: Required read-only cancellation observation on borrowed caller before/after. Main creates no thread and mutates no flag; original owned-worker get5/finally reset/shutdownNow/await5 fixture preserves parent flag.

raw.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block

reason: One typed close boundary and primary capture: close row then statement, preserve original Runtime/Error identity, apply existing SQL/unknown priority, no normal-success catch. New private close methods provide one policy Code point each; no quality exclusion or suppression. Original9/helper8 exercise body/close SQL/runtime/Error combinations/cycles.

raw.message: Avoid using equals() to compare against null

reason: Intentional direct generated record equals(null) contract invocation. Replacing with value!=null or assertNotEquals(null,value) would test JUnit/null checks instead of the target equals implementation. Null result false is an independent specified condition, alongside identity/type/every-component/hash vectors.
